title: ChatGPT Desktop (Codex) for Linux and Multi-Platform AI Coding Agents
summary: OpenAI's Codex is an AI-powered coding agent integrated into ChatGPT, designed to assist with software engineering tasks such as feature development, refactoring, migrations, and more. It supports multi-agent workflows, adapts to team-specific standards via 'Skills,' and automates routine tasks like issue triage and CI/CD monitoring. Codex is accessible across platforms (ChatGPT, IDE extensions, CLI) and is trusted by companies like Wonderful, Harvey, and Duolingo for improving code quality, reducing iteration time, and catching bugs early.
